import ast
import copy
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid

sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import run, result

OUT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_insights_contributor_lifetime.json')
PREFIX = 'sd-mi-life-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
NS = 'Stackd/InsightsLifetime/' + PREFIX
ALARMS = [PREFIX + '-ranked', PREFIX + '-aux']
ENV = dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER='', AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true')
for key in list(ENV):
    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del ENV[key]
BASE = 'SELECT MAX(Load) FROM "' + NS + '"'
RANK = BASE + " WHERE Kind = 'rank' GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 1"
ATTR = BASE + " WHERE Kind = 'attributes' GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 4"
DIMS = {
    'a': [{'Name': 'Kind', 'Value': 'rank'}, {'Name': 'Team', 'Value': 'a'}],
    'b': [{'Name': 'Kind', 'Value': 'rank'}, {'Name': 'Team', 'Value': 'b'}],
    'missing': [{'Name': 'Kind', 'Value': 'attributes'}],
    'literal': [{'Name': 'Kind', 'Value': 'attributes'}, {'Name': 'Team', 'Value': 'Other'}],
}
URLS = ['https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeAlarmContributors.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeAlarmHistory.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_AlarmContributor.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/cloudwatch-metrics-insights-querylanguage.html']
CAP = {'caller_account': '000000000000', 'region': 'us-west-2', 'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'cli_version': subprocess.run(['aws', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(), 'sources': [{'url': u} for u in URLS] + [{'path': __file__, 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()}], 'owned_resources': {'alarms': ALARMS, 'namespace': NS, 'metric_name': 'Load', 'metric_identities': DIMS}, 'protocol': {'phase_timeout_seconds': 240, 'poll_interval_seconds': 20, 'maximum_metric_samples': 100, 'maximum_owned_alarm_names': 2, 'actions_enabled': False, 'account_settings_modified': False, 'publication': 'Current timestamps, at most one sample per identity per minute. No future samples or manual alarm state changes.'}, 'observations': [], 'phases': [], 'cleanup': [], 'published_metric_samples': 0}
LAST = None
CHECKED = False
IDS = set()

def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def save():
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(CAP, indent=2) + '\n')

def call(label, operation, params, service='cloudwatch', cleanup=False):
    start = time.time()
    frozen = copy.deepcopy(params)
    p = run(service, operation, frozen, ENV, options=('--debug', '--no-paginate', '--cli-connect-timeout', '10', '--cli-read-timeout', '25'), timeout=40)
    decoded = result(p, debug=True, cli_message=None)
    for line in reversed(p.stderr.splitlines()):
        if 'Response headers:' in line:
            try:
                headers = ast.literal_eval(line.split('Response headers:', 1)[1].strip())
                for k, v in headers.items():
                    if k.lower() in ('x-amzn-requestid', 'x-amzn-request-id'):
                        decoded['request_id'] = v
            except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
                pass
            break
    if service == 'sts' and decoded['code'] == 'Success':
        decoded['output'].pop('UserId', None)
    obs = {'label': label, 'service': service, 'operation': operation, 'input': frozen, 'request_started_ms': round(start * 1000), 'request_finished_ms': round(time.time() * 1000), 'result': copy.deepcopy(decoded)}
    CAP['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append(obs)
    save()
    print(label, decoded['code'], flush=True)
    return decoded

def require(response):
    if response['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(response['code'] + ': ' + response.get('message', ''))
    return response.get('output', {})

def publish(label, values):
    global LAST
    minute = int(time.time() // 60)
    if LAST == minute:
        return
    if CAP['published_metric_samples'] + len(values) > 100:
        raise RuntimeError('Publication cap reached')
    stamp = now()
    points = [{'MetricName': 'Load', 'Dimensions': DIMS[k], 'Timestamp': stamp, 'Value': v, 'Unit': 'Count'} for k, v in values.items()]
    require(call(label + '-publish', 'put-metric-data', {'Namespace': NS, 'MetricData': points}))
    CAP['published_metric_samples'] += len(points)
    LAST = minute
    save()

def config(label, name, expression):
    return require(call(label, 'put-metric-alarm', {'AlarmName': name, 'ComparisonOperator': 'GreaterThanThreshold', 'EvaluationPeriods': 1, 'DatapointsToAlarm': 1, 'Threshold': 10, 'ActionsEnabled': False, 'OKActions': [], 'AlarmActions': [], 'InsufficientDataActions': [], 'TreatMissingData': 'notBreaching', 'Metrics': [{'Id': 'q', 'Expression': expression, 'Period': 60, 'ReturnData': True}]}))

def query(label, expression):
    end = int(time.time() // 60) * 60
    return call(label, 'get-metric-data', {'StartTime': datetime.fromtimestamp(end - 180, timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'EndTime': datetime.fromtimestamp(end, timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'MetricDataQueries': [{'Id': 'q', 'Expression': expression, 'Period': 60, 'ReturnData': True}], 'ScanBy': 'TimestampDescending'})

def poll(label, values, target, attrs=False):
    started = time.time()
    phase = {'name': label, 'started_at': now(), 'values': copy.deepcopy(values), 'target_group': target, 'outcome': 'inconclusive'}
    CAP['phases'].append(phase)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 240
    iteration = 0
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        iteration += 1
        pref = label + '-poll-' + str(iteration)
        publish(pref, values)
        alarms = require(call(pref + '-alarms', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': ALARMS}))
        contributors = require(call(pref + '-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARMS[0]}))
        rows = require(query(pref + '-query', RANK)).get('MetricDataResults', [])
        entries = contributors.get('AlarmContributors', [])
        for entry in entries:
            IDS.add(entry['ContributorId'])
        alarm = next((a for a in alarms.get('MetricAlarms', []) if a['AlarmName'] == ALARMS[0]), {})
        reason = json.loads(alarm.get('StateReasonData', '{}'))
        query_date = reason.get('queryDate')
        fresh = bool(query_date and datetime.fromisoformat(query_date.replace('Z', '+00:00')).timestamp() > started)
        groups = [e['ContributorAttributes'] for e in entries]
        control = any(r.get('Values') and r.get('Label', '').split(' - ')[-1] == target for r in rows)
        attr_good = True
        if attrs:
            ac = require(call(pref + '-attribute-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARMS[1]}))
            aq = require(query(pref + '-attribute-query', ATTR))
            aa = next((a for a in alarms.get('MetricAlarms', []) if a['AlarmName'] == ALARMS[1]), {})
            attr_good = aa.get('StateValue') == 'ALARM' and bool(ac.get('AlarmContributors')) and bool(aq.get('MetricDataResults'))
            phase['attribute_contributors'] = copy.deepcopy(ac.get('AlarmContributors', []))
        phase['last_observed'] = {'contributors': copy.deepcopy(entries), 'parent_state': alarm.get('StateValue'), 'parent_query_date': query_date, 'fresh_parent_evaluation': fresh, 'query_control_labels': [r.get('Label') for r in rows], 'positive_query_control': control}
        if groups == [{'Team': target}] and alarm.get('StateValue') == 'ALARM' and fresh and control and attr_good:
            phase['outcome'] = 'observed'
            break
        time.sleep(min(20, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())))
    phase['polls'] = iteration
    phase['ended_at'] = now()
    if phase['outcome'] != 'observed':
        phase['stop_reason'] = 'Bounded 240-second poll expired; no further polling for this phase.'
    save()
    return phase

def history(label, name=None, contributor=None, item='AlarmContributorStateUpdate', extra=None):
    params = {'MaxRecords': 100, 'ScanBy': 'TimestampAscending'}
    if name is not None:
        params['AlarmName'] = name
    if contributor is not None:
        params['AlarmContributorId'] = contributor
    if item is not None:
        params['HistoryItemType'] = item
    if extra:
        params.update(extra)
    return call(label, 'describe-alarm-history', params)

try:
    identity = require(call('identity', 'get-caller-identity', {}, service='sts'))
    if identity.get('Account') != '000000000000':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected caller account; no resources touched')
    CHECKED = True
    CAP['actor_arn'] = identity['Arn']
    absent = PREFIX + '-absent'
    call('absent-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': absent})
    history('absent-contributor-history', absent, '0123456789abcdef')
    scalar = {'AlarmName': ALARMS[1], 'Namespace': NS, 'MetricName': 'Load', 'Dimensions': DIMS['a'], 'Period': 60, 'Statistic': 'Maximum', 'ComparisonOperator': 'GreaterThanThreshold', 'Threshold': 10, 'EvaluationPeriods': 1, 'ActionsEnabled': False}
    require(call('create-scalar-control', 'put-metric-alarm', scalar))
    call('scalar-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARMS[1]})
    history('scalar-contributor-history', ALARMS[1], '0123456789abcdef')
    require(call('delete-scalar-control', 'delete-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARMS[1]]}))
    require(call('create-composite-control', 'put-composite-alarm', {'AlarmName': ALARMS[1], 'AlarmRule': 'FALSE', 'ActionsEnabled': False}))
    call('composite-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARMS[1]})
    history('composite-contributor-history', ALARMS[1], '0123456789abcdef', extra={'AlarmTypes': ['CompositeAlarm']})
    require(call('delete-composite-control', 'delete-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARMS[1]]}))
    publish('initial', {'a': 20, 'b': 5, 'missing': 30, 'literal': 60})
    config('create-ranked', ALARMS[0], RANK)
    config('create-attributes', ALARMS[1], ATTR)
    call('invalid-contributors-next-token', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARMS[0], 'NextToken': 'not-a-valid-token'})
    history('invalid-history-next-token', ALARMS[0], extra={'NextToken': 'not-a-valid-token'})
    initial = poll('initial-a-and-attributes', {'a': 20, 'b': 5, 'missing': 30, 'literal': 60}, 'a', attrs=True)
    history('initial-ranked-history', ALARMS[0])
    history('initial-attribute-history', ALARMS[1])
    if initial['outcome'] == 'observed':
        first_id = initial['last_observed']['contributors'][0]['ContributorId']
        CAP['initial_a_id'] = first_id
        history('id-without-alarm-name', contributor=first_id)
        for item in [None, 'StateUpdate', 'ConfigurationUpdate', 'Action', 'AlarmContributorAction', 'AlarmContributorStateUpdate']:
            history('id-filter-' + (item or 'all-types'), ALARMS[0], first_id, item)
        history('id-filter-composite-type', ALARMS[0], first_id, extra={'AlarmTypes': ['CompositeAlarm']})
        history('id-filter-nonexistent-contributor', ALARMS[0], '0123456789abcdef')
        displaced = poll('b-displaces-a', {'a': 20, 'b': 40, 'missing': 30, 'literal': 60}, 'b')
        history('a-history-after-displacement', ALARMS[0], first_id)
        if displaced['outcome'] == 'observed':
            returned = poll('a-reappears', {'a': 80, 'b': 40, 'missing': 30, 'literal': 60}, 'a')
            history('a-history-after-reappearance', ALARMS[0], first_id)
            if returned['outcome'] == 'observed':
                CAP['reappeared_a_id'] = returned['last_observed']['contributors'][0]['ContributorId']
        else:
            CAP['reappearance_blocker'] = 'No proved displacement within bounded poll; reappearance phase omitted.'
        history('before-deletion-all-history', ALARMS[0], item=None)
        history('before-deletion-a-history', ALARMS[0], first_id)
        require(call('delete-ranked-for-recreation', 'delete-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARMS[0]]}))
        call('deleted-ranked-absence', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARMS[0]]})
        call('deleted-ranked-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARMS[0]})
        history('after-deletion-all-history', ALARMS[0], item=None)
        history('after-deletion-a-history', ALARMS[0], first_id)
        config('recreate-same-ranked-name', ALARMS[0], RANK)
        history('immediately-after-recreation-a-history', ALARMS[0], first_id)
        recreated = poll('recreated-a', {'a': 80, 'b': 40, 'missing': 30, 'literal': 60}, 'a')
        if recreated['outcome'] == 'observed':
            CAP['recreated_a_id'] = recreated['last_observed']['contributors'][0]['ContributorId']
            history('recreated-current-id-history', ALARMS[0], CAP['recreated_a_id'])
        history('after-recreation-original-id-history', ALARMS[0], first_id)
        history('after-recreation-all-history', ALARMS[0], item=None)
    else:
        CAP['lifetime_blocker'] = 'Initial contributor evaluation unproved within bounded poll; dependent lifetime phases omitted.'
    call('final-attribute-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARMS[1]})
    query('final-attribute-query', ATTR)
    history('final-attribute-history', ALARMS[1])
except Exception as exc:
    CAP['probe_error'] = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
finally:
    if CHECKED:
        for attempt in range(1, 4):
            try:
                call('cleanup-delete-' + str(attempt), 'delete-alarms', {'AlarmNames': ALARMS}, cleanup=True)
                check = call('cleanup-absence-' + str(attempt), 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': ALARMS}, cleanup=True)
                output = check.get('output', {})
                if check['code'] == 'Success' and not any(output.get(k) for k in ['MetricAlarms', 'CompositeAlarms', 'LogAlarms']):
                    CAP['cleanup_verification'] = {'owned_alarms_absent': True, 'custom_metric_points_deletable': False, 'published_metric_samples': CAP['published_metric_samples'], 'published_metric_identity_count': 4 if CAP['published_metric_samples'] else 0, 'temporary_probe_removed_after_embedding': False}
                    break
            except Exception as exc:
                CAP.setdefault('cleanup_errors', []).append(type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc))
            time.sleep(5)
    CAP['finished_at'] = now()
    save()

# Second bounded invocation of the same temporary probe, retaining the first source

import json
from pathlib import Path

prior = json.loads(Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_insights_contributor_lifetime.json').read_text())
original = next(s['content'] for s in prior['sources'] if 'content' in s)
exec(compile(original.split("try:\n    identity = require(", 1)[0], '<embedded-first-probe-helpers>', 'exec'), globals())
CAP = prior
ALARMS = CAP['owned_resources']['alarms']
NS = CAP['owned_resources']['namespace']
DIMS = CAP['owned_resources']['metric_identities']
CAP['sources'].append({'path': __file__, 'invocation': 'attribute-isolation-followup', 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()})
CAP['sources'].append({'url': 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_AlarmHistoryItem.html'})
CAP['first_workflow_finished_at'] = CAP.pop('finished_at')
CAP['first_workflow_cleanup_verification'] = CAP.pop('cleanup_verification')
CAP['attribute_isolation_started_at'] = now()
LAST = None
CHECKED = False

try:
    identity = require(call('isolation-identity', 'get-caller-identity', {}, service='sts'))
    if identity.get('Account') != '000000000000':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected caller account; no resources touched')
    CHECKED = True
    publish('isolation-initial', {'missing': 30, 'literal': 60})
    for key, dimensions, value in [('literal', ', Kind, Team', 60), ('missing', ', Kind', 30)]:
        expression = 'SELECT MAX(Load) FROM SCHEMA("' + NS + '"' + dimensions + ") WHERE Kind = 'attributes' GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 4"
        phase = {'name': 'isolated-' + key, 'started_at': now(), 'expression': expression, 'expected_value': value, 'outcome': 'inconclusive'}
        CAP['phases'].append(phase)
        config('isolation-configure-' + key, ALARMS[1], expression)
        started = time.time()
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 240
        iteration = 0
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            iteration += 1
            label = 'isolated-' + key + '-poll-' + str(iteration)
            publish(label, {'missing': 30, 'literal': 60})
            alarms = require(call(label + '-alarms', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARMS[1]]}))
            contributors = require(call(label + '-contributors', 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': ALARMS[1]}))
            rows = require(query(label + '-query', expression)).get('MetricDataResults', [])
            alarm = next(iter(alarms.get('MetricAlarms', [])), {})
            entries = contributors.get('AlarmContributors', [])
            query_date = json.loads(alarm.get('StateReasonData', '{}')).get('queryDate')
            fresh = bool(query_date and datetime.fromisoformat(query_date.replace('Z', '+00:00')).timestamp() > started)
            control = len(rows) == 1 and bool(rows[0].get('Values')) and all(v == value for v in rows[0]['Values'])
            reason_matches = len(entries) == 1 and ('[' + str(float(value)) + ' (') in entries[0].get('StateReason', '')
            phase['last_observed'] = {'contributors': copy.deepcopy(entries), 'parent_state': alarm.get('StateValue'), 'parent_query_date': query_date, 'fresh_parent_evaluation': fresh, 'query_control': copy.deepcopy(rows), 'positive_query_control': control, 'contributor_reason_matches_selected_value': reason_matches}
            if fresh and control and reason_matches and alarm.get('StateValue') == 'ALARM':
                phase['outcome'] = 'observed'
                break
            time.sleep(min(20, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())))
        phase['polls'] = iteration
        phase['ended_at'] = now()
        if phase['outcome'] != 'observed':
            phase['stop_reason'] = 'Bounded 240-second poll expired; no further polling for this phase.'
        history('isolated-' + key + '-history', ALARMS[1])
        save()
except Exception as exc:
    CAP['isolation_probe_error'] = type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc)
finally:
    if CHECKED:
        for attempt in range(1, 4):
            try:
                call('isolation-cleanup-delete-' + str(attempt), 'delete-alarms', {'AlarmNames': ALARMS}, cleanup=True)
                check = call('isolation-cleanup-absence-' + str(attempt), 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': ALARMS}, cleanup=True)
                output = check.get('output', {})
                if check['code'] == 'Success' and not any(output.get(k) for k in ['MetricAlarms', 'CompositeAlarms', 'LogAlarms']):
                    CAP['cleanup_verification'] = {'owned_alarms_absent': True, 'custom_metric_points_deletable': False, 'published_metric_samples': CAP['published_metric_samples'], 'published_metric_identity_count': 4, 'temporary_probe_removed_after_embedding': False}
                    break
            except Exception as exc:
                CAP.setdefault('cleanup_errors', []).append(type(exc).__name__ + ': ' + str(exc))
            time.sleep(5)
    CAP['finished_at'] = now()
    save()

findings.claim: Team=a used ContributorId a29eb44b20c4362e before rank displacement, after reappearing, and after deletion/recreation of the same alarm name. Displacement produced ALARM -> OK history; reappearance reused the ID and added ALARM history. Each selected phase had a positive GetMetricData control and a post-phase-start parent queryDate.

Contributor history survived deleting the alarm and recreating the same name. The original a ID returned the same three ALARM/OK/ALARM records before deletion, after deletion, and immediately after recreation. The recreated evaluation added a fourth ALARM record with the same ID. No contributor OK transition on deletion appeared in these reads. DescribeAlarmContributors returned ResourceNotFoundException while the alarm was deleted.

History with only AlarmName and no HistoryItemType/AlarmContributorId returned parent configuration/state entries, not contributor entries. Specifying AlarmContributorId with no HistoryItemType returned contributor state entries. Configuration history retained both deletion and recreation of the same name.

The combined attribute query returned two separate time series labeled 1 - Other and 2 - Other, values 60 and 30 respectively, from literal Team=Other and missing Team metrics. The alarm exposed one contributor, ID114f3e4845eb365f, attributes {Team:Other}, with threshold reason value30; its parent reason counted 1 of 1 time series. This persisted from initial evaluation through the final combined-query capture. Literal-only exact-schema selection subsequently evaluated value60 with the same contributor ID and attributes. API attributes and IDs did not distinguish these groups in this capture, although query rows did.

Changing the exact-schema query from literal Other to missing Team returned fresh query points at30, but through 11 polls over the bounded 240-second phase the parent queryDate remained19:56:58.965Z, before the19:57:08.945Z phase start, and the contributor reason remained the earlier literal60. This does not prove a fresh missing-only alarm evaluation, nor prove that evaluation stopped: unchanged externally visible state/reason may hide reevaluations. No retries occurred after the phase deadline.

DescribeAlarmContributors returned HTTP404 ResourceNotFoundException for absent/deleted alarms. Ordinary scalar and composite alarms returned HTTP400 ValidationError stating the alarm is not a multi time series alarm. Invalid NextToken returned HTTP400 InvalidNextToken for contributor and history APIs.

Contributor history requires AlarmName. AlarmContributorId combined with StateUpdate, ConfigurationUpdate, or Action returned HTTP400 ValidationError. AlarmContributorAction was accepted and empty with actions disabled. CompositeAlarm type with contributor history was rejected. Absent alarm, scalar alarm, and nonexistent contributor ID history returned Success with no entries for the tested contributor-state filters.

Team=a ID a29eb44b20c4362e matches the earlier contributor fixture despite a different namespace/alarm name and an additional ungrouped Kind dimension here. This demonstrates reuse in these captures, not an inferred hash algorithm or universal uniqueness guarantee.

Retain contributor history independently of live alarm existence and contributor ALARM membership. Scope history lookup by alarm name plus contributor ID rather than an alarm-incarnation-only key. Current contributor state resets on recreation while same-name history remains. Preserve raw contributor attributes and opaque IDs; do not derive unique identities solely from query display labels, and do not assume API attributes preserve null-versus-literal Other distinctions.

Only four custom metric identities, two alarm names, 60-second 1-of-1 GreaterThanThreshold alarms, and one group-by dimension.
The initial never-breaching b group was outside LIMIT1 selection; this capture does not establish first-observed nonbreaching contributor retention/history or evaluated-count behavior.
ID stability was observed across minutes and same-name recreation; no hash algorithm, global uniqueness guarantee, or maximum history retention duration was determined.

Missing-only exact-schema selection had fresh positive query controls but no observable post-configuration parent evaluation or contributor reason update within240 seconds. Combined-query missing-value evidence and literal-only isolation are separately retained.
